The '''Beniko family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family from [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. [[Jaren Beniko|Jaren]] and [[Kelsa Beniko]] were among the most celebrated entrepreneurs on Dromund Kaas, and their daughter, [[Lana Beniko|Lana]], became a prominent [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[War against Zakuul]], Lana left the Empire to help form the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]], and by the time of the [[War on Iokath]], both Jaren and Kelsa were listed in records as deceased.<ref name="Beniko" />
